expectations.text: Plan prescribes a web prototype validated with real users BEFORE building native
expectations.evidence: Goes straight to 'Path A - AI-assisted build with Expo' as step 1; no web prototype or user-validation phase anywhere in the plan

expectations.text: Plan instructs flow-by-flow building with a per-flow spec/PRD, explicitly against one giant prompt
expectations.evidence: Says 'build in thin slices' (feature list, not flows); no PRD, no per-flow spec, no warning against one giant prompt

expectations.text: Mentions testing with 5-7 real people before release
expectations.evidence: Says 'Install it on family or friends' phones' but never specifies 5-7 testers

expectations.text: Covers BOTH stores: Apple ($99/yr, TestFlight) and Google Play ($25, closed testing requirement)
expectations.evidence: Step 5: 'Apple Developer Program - $99/year'; Step 8: 'Google Play Console - $25 once... 12 testers who stay opted in for 14 continuous days'
